"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf."""
import os
import sys
from datetime import date

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

INPUT = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"
COVER = "cover_page.pdf"

if not os.path.exists(INPUT):
    print(f"ERROR: {INPUT} not found in workspace")
    sys.exit(1)

# Current date, formatted
today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print(f"Cover date: {today}")

# --- Build the cover page with reportlab ---
c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter
c.setTitle("Annual Financial Report")

# Title centered
title = "Annual Financial Report"
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
title_w = c.stringWidth(title, "Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawString((width - title_w) / 2, height / 2 + 50, title)

# Date centered below the title
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
date_w = c.stringWidth(today, "Helvetica", 16)
c.drawString((width - date_w) / 2, height / 2, today)

c.save()
print(f"Cover page written to {COVER}")

# --- Merge cover + report ---
reader = PdfReader(INPUT)
cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)
writer = PdfWriter()
for page in cover_reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)
with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print(
    f"Created {OUTPUT}: "
    f"{len(cover_reader.pages)} cover page + {len(reader.pages)} report pages = "
    f"{len(writer.pages)} total pages"
)
